item.title: `open` loads local data or fetches structures in ChimeraX
item.content: The ChimeraX `open` command reads local files, URLs, or supported database identifiers. A four-character PDB identifier can be fetched directly, for example `open 2hyy`.
item.explanationMarkdown:
Examples:

```text
open 2hyy
open ~/structures/model.cif
```

ChimeraX can infer many formats from file suffixes, and database identifiers can be combined with source prefixes when needed. This is ChimeraX syntax; do not substitute legacy UCSF Chimera-specific commands without checking compatibility.
